items.label: Luxurious and Comfortable
items.value: The cloud sofa features a double layer of high resilience foam seat cushions, with ergonomic lumbar support design backrest, 3 back pillows and 2 arm pillows for a super cozy feeling of being surrounded by clouds.

items.label: Free Combination Ottoman
items.value: Adapt to any space, provides large deep seat, can be convertible into loveseat, L shape sofa, a sofa with chaises, even beds, you can put it anywhere as you like to meet your needs, make your own style.

items.label: Premium and Durability
items.value: The cloud sofa is made of high-quality skin-friendly Chenille fabric and solid wood frames, the weight capacity for each seat is 440 lbs, standing the test of time, it's a great choice for your furniture.

items.label: Three Boxes Packaging & Easy Assembly
items.value: We put all the parts in three boxes for easy transport and sometimes they arrive at different times, you can install it in 30 minutes by using the included detailed instructions. items.label: Customer Service
